---
id: dec-3004
kind: decision
title: Fixture for a realized_by target matching neither ref form
state: accepted
created: "2026-08-14T12:15:00Z"
alternatives:
  - option: Silently ignore a malformed realized_by target
    why_not: >
      A malformed target is a data bug, not an empty result; hiding it would
      make the join wrong in a way nothing downstream could ever notice.
edges:
  - type: realized_by
    to: "not-a-kazi-ref"
---

Fixture only, for E4-L3-T1. `"not-a-kazi-ref"` matches neither
`kazi:prop-<ref>` nor `kazi:goal-<id>` — no `kazi:` prefix at all — and must
produce a named parse error, not a silently-empty result.
